verdict.rationale: Dagster lets engineers define custom assets/ops as plain Python functions (software-defined assets, @dg.asset) which can wrap any custom API call, and provides scaffolding tools (create-dagster, dg scaffold defs, Components) to build reusable integration definitions rather than forking the codebase. However, evidence only shows pre-built connectors (Fivetran, Airbyte, dlt, dbt) and generic asset-authoring docs, not a dedicated low-code connector-builder or long-tail-API-specific framework/template comparable to a purpose-built connector SDK. missing for 10: a dedicated connector-development framework/SDK specifically for long-tail/custom APIs, low-code connector builder UI, and independent/community evidence of engineers successfully building such custom connectors without forking.
